name: Angel of Vitality
oracle_text:
Flying
If you would gain life, you gain that much life plus 1 instead.
This creature gets +2/+2 as long as you have 25 or more life.
blocked_sentences: If you would gain life, you gain that much life plus 1 instead.

needs.what: an additive life-gain replacement: the player-wide static replace_life_gain with an addend (e.g. gain_addend: 1) so each life-gain event for the affected player becomes that amount plus N, applied wherever life is gained (lifelink included), ordered with any gain_multiplier per 616.1 controller choice
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_life_gain only carries gain_multiplier, which the loader requires to be 2 or more, and engine/player_statics.life_gain_multiplier only multiplies; there is no addend key (counter_addend exists only for replace_counters). A you_gain_life trigger that gains 1 more is a different card (it uses the stack, and would itself trigger/repeat).
